propertyAccessPortability.scope: Reuse the public-Method accessibility strategy at the return of original PropertyValuesHolder.setupSetterOrGetter. Original AOSP lookup, numeric conversion, getter/setter algorithms and Method caches remain intact; no shadow class or parallel animation state.
